conclusion.text: STIFTELSEN BUREISEREN is an active foundation in real estate activities. In its 2025 accounts (company level, period 2025-01-01/2025-12-31) it reported revenue of NOK 650 940 and a profit of NOK 97 620, with positive equity of NOK 121 347. It has a registered CEO, board chair and auditor, and its 2025 accounts were audited. The most recent dated item found is "Godkjente årsregnskap" (category: Approved annual accounts), published 2026-06-30 (Brønnøysundregistrene – kunngjøringer). No risk flags were found in the registers checked (bankruptcy, liquidation, compulsory dissolution, negative equity, losses).

Selskapet tilbyr også relaterte tjenester som installasjon, fjernsupport og programvareoppdateringer.
